gallery.title: File:Abandoned mine in the San Juan Mountains, just above Silverton, Colorado.jpg
gallery.source: Abandoned mine in the San Juan Mountains, just above Silverton, Colorado
gallery.description: An abandoned mine sits a few hundred feet above the town of Silverton, Colorado, in the San Juan Mountain Range of the Rocky Mountains, in July 2020. Though not much remains, part of the mine structure remains and is surrounded by phenomenal scenery.

gallery.title: File:Abandoned Mine at Silverton, Colorado.jpg
gallery.description: A big abandoned mine sits near the town of Silverton, Colorado, which used to be a big mining town served by 4 different railroads, and had numerous other mining towns like Eureka and Chattanooga surrounding it. Photo taken in 2019.

gallery.title: File:Rusty, abandoned truck (8862016148).jpg
gallery.artist: Sandy Horvath-Dori from Grand Junction, CO, USA
gallery.description:
This old truck is along the Alpine Scenic Byway, a 4WD loop in the San Juan mountains near Silverton, Colorado.  

A car enthusiast came along as we were photographing this and told us he thought it was an old Dodge circa 1920-1924.
